text: 金十数据10月9日讯，据外媒报道，随着冬季临近，欧洲各国政府正努力寻找缓解能源价格冲击的方法。欧盟委员会将评估在整个欧盟范围内对能源企业超额利润征税的潜在影响，以减轻消费者和企业的负担。据知情人士透露，欧盟委员会周五在卢森堡举行的财政部长会议上表示，将研究实施欧盟统一能源暴利税的可行性，并考虑利用相关税收收入为民众提供救济。此前，包括德国在内的多个欧盟成员国已呼吁研究这一措施。然而，欧盟气候事务委员沃普克·胡克斯特拉表示，该措施最终筹集的资金远低于最初预计的500亿欧元，并引发了多起法律诉讼，欧盟至今仍在处理相关案件。胡克斯特拉周五抵达财政部长会议现场时
text_en: Jinshi Data, October 9 - According to foreign media reports, as winter approaches, European governments are working hard to find ways to ease the energy price shock. The European Commission will assess the potential impact of taxing excess profits of energy companies across the entire EU, in order to reduce the burden on consumers and businesses. According to people familiar with the matter, the European Commission said at a meeting of finance ministers held in Luxembourg on Friday that it would study the feasibility of implementing an EU-wide energy windfall tax and consider using the related tax revenue to provide relief to the public. Previously, multiple EU member states, including Germany, had called for studying this measure. However, EU Climate Commissioner Wopke Hoekstra said that the measure ultimately raised far less than the initially estimated 50 billion euros and triggered multiple legal proceedings, with the EU still handling related cases to date. Hoekstra said on Friday upon arriving at the venue of the finance ministers' meeting.
